slice: Natural conversation round 35: Novi never invents physical life stories; topic fallback never picks question words

before.what's going on in the world?: The coffee shop down the street just started serving that oat milk latte I've been curious about. I've been meaning to stop by and try it.

mechanism: general no-body clause forbids invented physical experiences; _extract_topic filters contraction/plural forms whose stem is a stopword (whats->what, hows->how) so the fallback never says 'no good answer on what's'
